site.title: Vadym Tyemirov | Essays, Tools, and Experiments
site.description: Vadym Tyemirov's personal site: essays, research-backed tools, and standalone experiments published directly under tyemirov.net.

hero.title: Essays, tools, and experiments.
hero.summary: Vadym Tyemirov is a product-minded engineering leader who bridges the gap between cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and scalable enterprise infrastructure.
hero.detail: With a career spanning Meta, BlackRock, Shopify, and Morgan Stanley, he focuses on turning complex technical challenges into revenue-generating products. This domain collects the resulting essays, tools, and experiments in one place.

projects.title: Minimum Sustainable Modern Civilization
projects.summary: Estimate the population floor needed to sustain a modern market economy under staffing, dependency, resilience, autarky, and demographic constraints.

essay.label: Companion essay
essay.title: How Big Does a Modern Civilization Need to Be?

projects.title: Decision Planes
projects.summary: Turn vague yes-or-no choices into explicit reasoning over confidence, stakes, expected value, uncertainty, and reversibility.

essay.label: Companion essay
essay.title: Stop asking "Is this good or bad?"

projects.title: The Vector of Liberty
projects.summary: Compare states by the friction they impose on concrete actions through taxes, permits, delays, and penalties, weighted against the kind of life you actually want to live.

projects.title: Timeline
projects.summary: Analyze ongoing processes and event thresholds to determine if a system is stable, ready for a decision, or drifting into failure.

projects.title: The Age of the Meta-Manager
projects.summary: A framework for engineering leadership in the AI era: moving from managing people to managing the systems that manage the work.
